about.title: About MAK Comfort
text: The name Sherrell is synonymous with unwavering dedication and commitment to superior customer service in the heart of Houston. As family-owned business, we have served the local community with exceptional air conditioning and HVAC services for over 18 years. But our story extends beyond that; it's a two decade long story of passion, legacy, and a commitment to making homes comfortable, one service at a time.

Our founder and operator, Steven Sherrell, is more than just an HVAC veteran; he is the heart of MAK Comfort. Born and raised in a family deeply rooted in the HVAC business, Steven's passion for providing superior service was ingrained in him from the start. Years of honing his restaurant and supermarket refrigeration skills before returning to his roots in residential AC repair have shaped his expertise and dedication to maintaining a legacy.

Steven founded MAK Comfort by seeing a need in Houston for a genuinely exceptional HVAC company, one that was not only knowledgeable but also profoundly cared about its customers. For over a decade, his hands-on approach, rich experience, and unwavering dedication have been instrumental in keeping Houston homes comfortable, regardless of the season.
